artworks.title: The Waterfall at Tivoli with the Villa of Maecenas
artworks.medium: graphite with white heightening on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an aqueduct structure dominating the top left portion. The horizon line is not distinctly visible, suggested by the linear structure at the upper part of the image, which includes a series of arches. The structure is drawn with precise pencil strokes. The color palette is subdued, primarily light blue. There are lightly sketched trees and a rocky landscape with water flowing down the rocks in the foreground. In the distance, there are rolling hills and a few architectural elements, all drawn with fine lines.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait Working at a Lithographic Press
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in profile, facing left, leaning forward over a workbench. He is wearing a short-sleeved shirt, a cloth cap, and an apron tied around his waist. The workbench has various woodworking tools, including chisels and what seems to be a printing press machine. In the background, there are more tools and a workshop setting.

artworks.title: The Erectheum, West Elevation [left half]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a classical building's west elevation. The sketch showcases the ornamental columns, entablature, and precise measurements and annotations. The columns are in a classical style, consistent with ancient Greek or Roman architecture, with an emphasis on proportion and detail. The drawing includes columns with capitals, a detailed entablature, and a pediment, along with numbers and letters suggesting structural considerations or component identifications.

artworks.title: Face in repose
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a man facing the camera with a slight turn to his right. He has a stern expression, prominent cheekbones, a furrowed brow, thinning hair on the top of his head, and slightly unkempt longer strands on the sides. He wears a light-colored, partially unbuttoned shirt revealing his chest, and dark pants or a belt. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain with a subtle gradient from light to dark.

artworks.title: Face in repose
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up. He has a mustache, medium-length wavy hair, and crossed arms. He is looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. The man is wearing a loose-fitting, light-colored shirt and there is no visible jewelry. The background is plain with a sepia tone. The photograph is presented within an oval frame with darkened edges.

artworks.title: Attention
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person's upper body, focusing on their head and shoulders. The individual is seated upright, with their face aimed directly at the camera. They have a noticeable bald head, with wrinkles crossing their forehead. Their facial expression appears neutral, and they have drooping eyelids. Their clothing consists of a light-colored, loose-fitting garment. There is another figure partially visible to the left side of the frame, who seems to be wearing dark clothing. This person is obscured and only partially visible. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: A relaxed face (left); Profound attention (right)
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man facing the camera directly from the chest up. He has a furrowed brow and distinctive features suggesting age or life experience. His hair is sparse and combed back, revealing much of his scalp. He wears a loose, open-collared shirt. To his right, an arm extends into the frame holding a metal rod touching his forehead. On the lower right, a dark, bulky apparatus with visible mechanical components is positioned. The background is a simple, muted backdrop.

artworks.title: The muscle of attention (left); Eyebrow contraction due to bright light (right)
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a young girl sitting in a formal portrait setting. She has dark hair in braids, wears a dress with lace detailing, and has a pendant around her neck. An older man to the right leans in to examine her ear with an otoscope. The background includes a plain curtain and a patterned cloth draping across the foreground.

artworks.title: Attention (left); Reflection (right)
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a man facing the camera directly. He is shown bare-chested under a loosely draped shirt, with pronounced facial features including a furrowed brow and deep-set eyes. He has thinning hair at the top, with longer, wavy strands at the sides. The man's open, wrinkled shirt is visible. The background is plain and sepia-toned, giving a vintage effect. A hand on the left side of the image is holding an object that extends towards the man's face, possibly touching his eyebrow.

artworks.title: Plate 14: Designed to show a comparison between the maximal contraction of the superior part of m. orbicularis oculi and m. corrugator supercilii, in the same individual. On the left, very strong electrization of the superior part of m. orbicularis oculi: dissatisfaction, somber thoughts. On the right, electrization of m. corrugator supercilii.
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with their upper body visible, centered in an oval frame. The individual sits facing the camera directly, with their facial expression showing deep lines and furrows, particularly on the forehead and around the eyes. They have sparse hair that is combed back. Their clothing consists of a light-colored shirt with an open collar. There are two hands visible in the frame; one is adjusting a wire attached to the individual's face, while the other holds an object at their cheek, possibly also connected to wires. There is no jewelry seen on the person. The background appears plain and unfocused, emphasizing the centered figure.

artworks.title: Expression of severity
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows the upper part of a man's body, focusing on his head and shoulders. He is seated upright with a neutral expression, staring straight ahead. The man has a mustache, and his hair is slightly wavy, extending to the sides of his head. He is wearing a light, open-collared shirt, revealing part of his chest. In front of him, two hands can be seen holding measuring instruments to his face, positioned at his eyebrows and nose. These hands belong to someone out of the frame, as their forearms are visible. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Attention (left); Severity, aggression (right)
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated from the waist up in the center of the frame. His left hand is tucked into his partially open shirt. He is facing the camera directly and has a lined forehead and prominent cheekbones, with an intense expression. He has receding hair, showing a fair amount of forehead, with longer hair at the sides. He wears a loose, light-colored shirt with ruffled sleeves and no visible accessories or jewelry. A hand from an unseen person extends from the left side of the image, holding a string or pendulum above the man's head. The background is plain and slightly textured in a sepia tone, without any additional elements.

artworks.title: Aggression, wickedness
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a man conducting an experiment with electrical apparatus on a model or mannequin. The photograph features a bald figure on the left adjusting something connected to another mannequin or model in the center. Thin wires are attached to the central figure's face, leading back towards the hand of the left figure.

artworks.title: Spasm of m. corrugator supercilii under very strong light (left); A relaxed face (photographed in full sunshine) (right)
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a man depicted from the waist up. His facial features include a furrowed brow and a slightly downturned mouth. He has thin, combed-back hair. The man is wearing a loose-fitting, open-collared shirt that reveals part of his chest. One of his hands is visible, resting against his torso. Another hand is holding an instrument or device against the side of his head. The background is dark.

artworks.title: Painful recollection or painful thoughts
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated with his arms resting in front of him. He has a distinctive facial expression with slightly furrowed brows and a prominent mustache that curves upward. His hair is dark and styled with volume. The man is wearing a white collared shirt with a dark, patterned vest over it. The background is plain and dark. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held in the image.

artworks.title: Extreme pain, the head of Christ (left); Memory of love or ecstatic gaze (right)
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays a man's upper body, positioned at a slight angle. He has prominent facial features including a mustache and slightly wavy hair. He is wearing a loosely buttoned shirt, revealing part of his chest. The background is a plain, dark canvas. No accessories or other objects are visible in the image.

artworks.title: Attention, attentive gaze (left); Painful attention (right)
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman with her upper body visible. She is looking slightly upward with defined facial features, including pronounced cheekbones and creases around her eyes. Her dark hair is neatly brushed back, and she is wearing a dress with a patterned fabric, high collar, decorative lace collar, buttons down the front, and a ribbon detail. Another person is partially visible behind her, appearing to hold a metal instrument near her head. The background is dark and nondescript.

artworks.title: Painful memories
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a young girl's upper body and head. She is seated, facing an older person's arm holding an object near her ear. The girl's face is visible in profile with a calm expression. She has neat hair and small earrings, wearing a high-collared dress with lace trim. The background is plain and dark, and there is a patterned covering below the girl.

artworks.title: A relaxed face (left); False joy or laughter (right)
artworks.creditLine: Eugene L. and Marie-Louise Garbáty Fund
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of two men. The man in the foreground is facing the camera and is seated with his shoulders slightly turned to the right. He has an aged face with pronounced lines and a mostly bald head with some hair on the sides. His facial expression suggests a slight smile. His clothing is a loosely worn shirt with a large V-neckline, revealing his chest and tied at the waist. The man behind him, partially visible, is seen from the side wearing glasses and a suit, seemingly interacting with the first man's face. The background is plain and neutral with no visible objects or scenery.

artworks.title: A false, incomplete expression of agreeable surprise, or admiration
artworks.creditLine: W. Bruce and Delaney H. Lundberg Fund, in Honor of the 25th Anniversary of Photography at the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man sitting upright, centered in the frame. His facial features include pronounced lines and wrinkles, a wide grin, and large eyes. The man has thinning hair that is combed back, and a prominent mustache. He is wearing a light-colored shirt that appears slightly disheveled, with the collar open. Several hands are seen around him; one is holding a metal apparatus around his head, which is connected to wires appearing to manipulate his facial expression. The background is a plain, smooth wall with a sepia-toned finish.

artworks.title: Slight lowering of the angle of the mouth due to depression (left); False laughter (right)
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a person facing the camera. The individual is seated upright, with their face prominently visible. They have straight, dark hair that is pulled back tightly, revealing a clear forehead. Their facial expression appears neutral, with a closed-lipped smile and slightly narrowed eyebrows. The person is dressed in a dark garment with lighter-colored buttons near the neckline over a lighter inner shirt. A hand, not belonging to the individual, is visible in the lower-left corner of the image, holding a string or wire that is in contact with the person's cheek. The background of the image is a plain, neutral tone with no discernible details.

artworks.title: Scornful disgust (left); Scornful laughter (right)
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a woman facing forward but slightly turned to her left. Her hair is dark, pulled back, revealing her forehead. Her facial expression is relaxed, with eyes closed. She is wearing a dark garment with a light, patterned stripe along the edges and large buttons. Two hands are in the image; one is holding a U-shaped wire tool against her mouth. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The attention attracted by an object that provokes lascivious ideas and desires
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile from the waist up, seated with his body slightly turned to the side. His facial features are prominent with a bald head and thinning hair at the sides. He has a distinct, sharply pointed nose and his mouth is open, revealing his teeth. The man is wearing a light-colored robe or loose garment. Surrounding him are several hands holding metal instruments or electrodes, placed on his face and head. The background appears to be plain and indistinct.

artworks.title: A portrait, seen in profile, of a man 42 years old, stupefied by the abuse of alcohol; his nose is aquiline
artworks.creditLine: Edward E. MacCrone Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person in a profile view facing right. The individual has prominent facial features, short combed-back hair, and wears a light-colored robe. There are no visible accessories. The background is dark, contrasting with the lighter foreground within an oval frame.
